mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.name, s.goal, s.status, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.created_at, COALESCE(stats.total_issues, 0) AS total_issues, COALESCE(stats.done_issues, 0) AS done_issues, COALESCE(stats.in_progress_issues, 0) AS in_progress_issues, COALESCE(stats.todo_issues, 0) AS todo_issues, COALESCE(stats.overdue_issues, 0) AS overdue_issues FROM sprint s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.sprint_id, COUNT(*) AS total_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = true) AS done_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND ist.category = 'in_progress') AS in_progress_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND ist.category != 'in_progress') AS todo_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_issues FROM issue i LEFT JOIN issue_status ist ON ist.id = i.status_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.sprint_id ) stats ON stats.sprint_id = s.id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY CASE s.status WHEN 'active' THEN 1 WHEN 'planned' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 END, s.created_at DESC
